*   **Wednesday:** 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00

I will now write a message to Brad in the shared workspace, listing these available slots. This will enable him to check the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor to find a time that works for all four partners. After posting the message, I will end my session to allow Brad to take his turn.
